items.headline: India's August CPI inflation expected to rise to 4.80%
items.summary: Forecasts suggest India's August Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation will rise to 4.80% from 4.45% in July, exceeding the RBI's 4% target for the third consecutive month, primarily due to higher food and fuel prices.

items.headline: RBI to reassess growth and inflation dynamics at October MPC meeting
items.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated on September 11 that the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) will re-evaluate growth and inflation at its October 5-7 meeting, considering the impact of rising crude oil prices.

items.headline: RBI to conduct ₹100,000 crore open-market bond sales
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is set to conduct open-market bond sales in three tranches (September 17, 21, and 28) totaling ₹100,000 crore to absorb surplus liquidity, which could lead to upward pressure on bond yields.

items.headline: US FOMC meeting on interest rates eyed amid strong job growth
items.summary: Global markets are closely watching the US Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting on September 15-16, with stronger-than-expected US job growth increasing expectations of a potential Fed rate hike.

items.headline: Rising crude oil prices fuel inflation fears globally
items.summary: Middle East conflicts are driving up crude oil prices, contributing to global inflation fears and complicating the efforts of central banks to ease monetary policy.

items.headline: FPIs continue net selling in Indian equities
items.summary: Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) have been net sellers, withdrawing ₹13,138 crore in the first two weeks of September, bringing the total outflow to ₹2.37 lakh crore so far in 2026.

items.headline: Several companies to report quarterly results this week
items.summary: Upcoming quarterly results this week include CMI (September 14 & 15), Sunshine Pictures Ltd (September 15), Supreme Engineering (September 16), and Tempsens Instruments (India) Ltd (September 16).

items.headline: Nifty 500 companies show strong revenue and profit growth in FY26
items.summary: A dataset of 451 Nifty 500 companies indicates combined revenue increased to an estimated ₹164.2 lakh crore in FY26, with net profit up 14% to ₹18.2 lakh crore from FY25, and revenue growth around 6% year-on-year.

items.headline: Nifty 500 companies' capex rises, signaling expansion phase
items.summary: Aggregate capital expenditure (capex) of Nifty 500 companies has risen from ₹3.91 lakh crore in FY16 to ₹9.98 lakh crore in FY25, suggesting a significant shift towards business expansion.

items.headline: Nifty Private Bank and IT sectors gain, Realty and Metal decline in previous session
items.summary: In the prior trading session, Nifty Private Bank and Nifty IT sectors experienced the most gains, while Nifty Realty and Nifty Metal sectors saw the steepest declines. Broad selling was noted across IT, Metal, Realty, and Auto sectors, with Financial Services providing some stability.

items.headline: Several companies have upcoming ex-dividend or record dates
items.summary: Notable companies with a September 14 record date for final dividends include Aarti Industries, Apar Industries, Balmer Lawrie and Company, Blue Jet Healthcare, and CMS Info Systems. Entertainment Network (India) Limited (ENIL) will go ex-dividend soon for ₹2, payable October 25. Blue Dart Express will trade ex-dividend on September 15 for a final dividend of ₹25 per share.

items.headline: Corporate Laws (Amendment) Bill 2026 to impact M&A transactions
items.summary: The Corporate Laws (Amendment) Bill 2026 proposes significant changes to the Companies Act, 2013, and the Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008, affecting M&A transaction planning, including expanded eligibility for fast-track mergers and modified buyback conditions.

items.headline: Vedanta, Tata Steel, and Adani Ports highlighted for improving debt metrics
items.summary: Vedanta, Tata Steel, and Adani Ports are identified for their improving debt metrics through FY26, driven by debt reduction initiatives, strong cash flow generation, and consistent cash flow generation, respectively.

items.headline: Shaily Engineering Plastics and Schneider Electric Infrastructure identified as growth stocks
items.summary: Shaily Engineering Plastics (customized plastic components, especially for pharma) and Schneider Electric Infrastructure (products/systems for electricity distribution, digital grid upgrades) are highlighted as growth stocks with strong earnings expansion potential.

items.headline: Axis Securities raises December 2026 Nifty target to 27,360
items.summary: Axis Securities increased its December 2026 Nifty target to 27,360, citing an earnings upgrade for FY27/FY28, strong macroeconomic fundamentals, sustained government capex, GST 2.0 reforms, and an improving corporate earnings cycle, with Nifty earnings expected to grow at a 13% CAGR over FY23–FY28.

items.headline: Axis Securities cautions on near-term volatility, advises liquidity
items.summary: Axis Securities cautioned about potential near-term market volatility due to geopolitical tensions, crude oil fluctuations, and currency movements, advising investors to maintain liquidity to capitalize on dips in high-quality companies.
